page.layout: One page of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top. Page number at top right. Catchword at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: Primo qviden[?] defectione Pro-vinciarum Belgicarum, quæ facta A. C. 1581. deinde defectione Portugal-liæ A. C. 1640. Belgæ enim Rem-publicam instituerunt & Portugalli Regem Johannem Bragantiæ Du-cem crearunt.
main_text.head: FRANCICA.1.Fran-cisca
Periodus I.
main_text.p: Prima mentio Francorum in tempora Imperatoris Probi incidit.
Ortus Franco-rum.Nam qvicunqve populi per Germaniam & Galliam à Romanis deficiebant Franci,i. e. Liberi homines dicebantur.

page.notes: Right margin notes: "1.Fran-cisca" beside the heading FRANCICA (the second line is partly obscured, reading uncertain); "Ortus Francorum." beside the paragraph "Nam qvicunqve". The first letter of "qviden" and the first word of the line "Primo" are doubtful; the form may be "quidem" with a worn abbreviation. Running head and page number read from the printed page; the page number is faint. Show-through from the facing page is present at the edges and is not transcribed. Catchword "Pri" is at the foot right, with a printed dot after it.
